# Version 3.119.5 (Unreleased)
> **Apple TFM alignment and WinUI fix**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM alignment and fixes a WinUI Projection DLL resolution failure.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers** — SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI failed to locate the WinUI Projection DLL under .NET 9 due to a path resolution change introduced in that SDK. The lookup is now corrected. ([#4086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4086))

## Platform

- **Apple platform TFMs aligned to SDK conventions** — Library TFMs are updated to version 26.0 and app TFMs use the unversioned form, matching Apple's SDK conventions and fixing TFM mismatch warnings for consumers building against iOS 26 / macOS 26. — ❤️ [@drasticactions](https://github.com/drasticactions) ([#4579](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4579))
